title: ALIGNER: ONE GLOBAL TOKEN IS WORTH MILLIONS OF PARAMETERS WHEN ALIGNING LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS
reasoning: The paper includes a significant evaluation component on 'Value (Human Preference) Alignment' using the PKU-Beaver Safety Benchmark. It benchmarks the model's ability to respond to prompts involving ethical and moral dilemmas across categories such as 'Immoral,' 'Social Bias,' 'Crime,' and 'Emotional Harm,' and provides extensive response samples evaluating these ethical dimensions.
